privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy explains how {brand} collects, uses and protects your personal data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: Data We Collect
sections.text: When you apply or contact us, we collect your first name, age range, city, WhatsApp number, and any details you share about your setup and availability.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.text: This data is used solely for initial contact and evaluating your application. We do not use it for any other purpose.

sections.title: No Selling of Data
sections.text: We never sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.text: We retain application data only as long as necessary to evaluate and follow up on your application.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.text: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data at any time. To exercise this right, contact us at contact@[domain].
